_about: Screenshots of the game for the guide (data/docs/game.md), the tutorial and the encyclopedia - shown where their text has ![caption](shot:id). tests/doc_shots.gd sets each moment up; tools/doc_shots.py takes them, draws the notes over them (an infographic: labels with arrows, boxes, numbered steps - in 1920 x 1080 screen units) and saves data/docs/shots/<id>.jpg. 'sources': the files the picture shows - when one changes, the shot is out of date (test_doc_shots) until taken again.

space3d.caption: 3D space (preview): an ocean world below - real procedural ground from orbit down - its clouds and air; your ship from behind, over the sights, the compass bar and the flight panel.

notes.text: The readout: the drive, the throttle, latitude and longitude
The compass bar: your heading, what's known round you
Your health: shields, hull, fuel
ALT: your height over the world below
VEL: your speed
The virtual stick: the mouse steers
Real ground, seen from orbit: seas, coasts, clouds

space3d_ground.caption: Low over the same world: its sky, clouds overhead, sea and coast - the ground finer the closer you are.

notes.text: Its own sky: air and clouds
Coast and sea - finer the lower you fly
The plumes follow the throttle

space3d_foot.caption: On foot on an ocean world: the 2D game's animals in 3D - a herd of mushroom mammoths, an eagle overhead.

notes.text: Olives and planes: the Greek woods
You, on foot: W A S D, Shift runs
Your health

space3d_fight.caption: Pirate raiders: the target's shields and hull, where to aim to hit it, your lasers.

notes.text: The raider, targeted: its shields and hull on the panel
Your target's window: it, live - shields, hull, speed, weapons
Your lasers' bolts
Ring: aim there to hit it (the lead)

space3d_hangar.caption: Docked: down the lift into the port under the platform - out of your ship on the hall's floor, the concourse's doors and windows ahead.

notes.text: The empire's emblem over the port's hall
Doors to the concourse and the rooms: bar, lounge, offices, services
The lift you came down on

space3d_pad.caption: Docking by hand: the pad outlined with a line dropped from your ship to its deck, and the landing display - the pad from above (its top edge bold, its axis and chevron), your heading off its axis, the height tape, the level bubble, the signed thrust.

notes.text: Heading: your nose off the pad's axis - set down square
Your pad, outlined - the line drops to the deck under you
The pad from above: steer the square under your ship
Level, speed, thrust: touch down in green
Height over the deck, climbing or sinking
The station's core and ring

space3d_sunset.caption: Dusk on an ocean world, along the line between day and night: the sun low and golden, the sky deep blue overhead and orange round the horizon, the clouds lit from below.

notes.text: The sun setting, its glow round it
The clouds lit from below
Deep blue overhead

space3d_rays.caption: The sun's rays: shafts of light through the gaps in the trees and the clouds, by day in a world's air.

space3d_storm.caption: A storm on an ocean world: its cell heavy and dark overhead, the rain slanting in its wind, lightning, the ground dark and wet, puddles in the hollows - the HUD's weather, temperature and radioactivity by your gauge.

notes.text: The weather, temperature, radioactivity
Rain slanting in the storm's wind
The ground dark and wet

space3d_snow.caption: Snow on an ice world: the cell's snow falling and lying on the ground.

notes.text: A blizzard, -30 °C
Snow falling all round you
Snow lying on the ground

space3d_town.caption: A town on an ocean world: the palace's court and its red columns, the wings round it, its people about their day - in its empire's colours.

notes.text: The grand staircase up onto the roofs
Fresco bands, cornices: the palace's wings round its court
Its people, in the empire's colours
The altar with its horns

space3d_monster.caption: An unknown bio-signature: one of the old monsters at its lair, coming for you.

notes.text: One of the old monsters, hundreds of metres long
Its shields and hull

space3d_people.caption: A Minoan city's people: a palace guard, the androids with their laser rifle, laser bow and labrys.

notes.text: A Minoan android with its labrys
An android with its laser bow

space3d_inside.caption: Inside a palace: the throne room - walk in through the doorways off the court.

notes.text: The throne, gypsum, benches either side
Painted panels behind it
Indoors a warm light goes with you

space3d_climb.caption: Climbing a palace wall: Space against it takes hold, W up it, hand over hand - over the top onto its roof.

notes.text: Hand over hand, feet in turn
Space again lets go

space3d_road.caption: A road between the towns: packed earth winding over the land, a caravan on it - its guards, its traders, a pack donkey with the goods.

notes.text: A caravan: guards, traders, a pack donkey
The road between the towns

space3d_dungeon.caption: Below a world: an old labyrinth's halls, its torches, its dead - skeleton warriors and a demon.

notes.text: Skeleton warriors: sword and shield
A demon: fire from afar, claws up close
Torches light the old halls

space3d_cave.caption: A cave in the ground: its passages carved into the hill, walked straight into - your lamp on, its dead in its chambers, a chest in the deepest.

notes.text: A skeleton warrior
The demon lord, deepest in
A passage on, deeper into the hill
Its chest: drachmas, once

space3d_mining.caption: Mining an asteroid: the rock scanned, its veins marked on it, the beam cutting one - its heat held in the green band.

notes.text: The mining beam, cutting a vein
Its veins, marked once it's scanned
Heat in the green: resonance builds

space3d_dig.caption: Mining on foot: a mineral deposit under your sights, the mining beam cutting it - its heat on the bar, what you've dug beneath.

notes.text: A deposit: crystals of the world's minerals
The mining beam on it (fire)
What's left, the beam's heat, what you've dug

space3d_digging.caption: Digging: the terrain digger out (V), its beam carving the ground - a trench swept through it, solid voxels round the carves.

notes.text: Carved ground: voxels round the carves
The digger out (V): its sights and heat

space3d_start.caption: A new game: on foot on Amnissos by a city's landing field - its ore buyer, courier's office and local pilot - the tutorial's panel top right, the scanner's marks.

notes.text: The tutorial: the next step, what it pays

space3d_trader.caption: Aboard a trader down in the port: up its stern ramp into its hold - its rooms fitted inside its hull, the quarters and the bridge on ahead.

notes.text: The doorway on to its crew quarters
Its cargo along the hold's sides
Where you are aboard

space3d_port.caption: The port's bar: its keeper behind the counter, the windows out to space - E to talk (news, work).

notes.text: E beside them: talk - who they are, the news, work
Windows out to space

map3d.caption: The solar map: Knossos in 3D - its worlds on their orbits, the stations and gates on their stems over the system's plane, the swept part bright, a world picked and its details beside the map, a course set to a station.

notes.text: A world, picked: its orbit, stem and ring
Stations and gates over the system's plane
Its details - set a course to it
Everything known here, nearest first

galaxy3d.caption: The galaxy map: the systems you've been in, in 3D over the galactic plane - the empires' territories glowing round them, lanes fading off to uncharted systems, a route plotted and the picked system's details.

notes.text: Only the systems you've been in show
Lanes fade off to uncharted systems
Your route, flowing to its end
The system's details; plot a route

planet3d.caption: The planet map: the world you're on as a 3D globe of its real ground - what you've explored of it bright, the rest under the fog; its towns, caves and camps marked where you've seen them, you and your ship, a town picked and its details.

notes.text: The ground you've seen; the rest under the fog
The map's own tabs: planet, solar system, galaxy
A town you've walked into: click it for its plan
Pirate camps, where you've seen them

town_plan3d.caption: A town's plan: a city you've walked into, from above, north up - its palace, houses, shrine and storehouse, the landing field and the people by it named: the ore buyer, the courier's office and the local pilot.

notes.text: The ore buyer, courier and pilot by the landing field
The palace in the middle of the city
North up

space3d_vein.caption: The scanner's pulse (right click): a vein of ore under the ground glows through it in its mineral's colour - on the ground only, whatever stands on it in front; where to dig with the terrain digger (the parts dug into grey; dug, its ore shows in the pit's walls); its mark gives the mineral, what's in it and how deep.

notes.text: The vein's hologram, through the ground
Its mark: mineral, units, depth

space3d_underwater.caption: Diving under the sea of an ocean world: the light falling through the water, caustics on the floor, kelp, corals, sponges and the sea's animals round you.

notes.text: Kelp and sea grass swaying in the current
Corals, sponges, boulders on the floor
Caustics: the surface's light on the floor

space3d_building.caption: Building: a Minoan house put up from the kit's pieces - foundations, walls, a door, windows, a porch of red columns under a triangle roof, front steps, a balustrade over the front - and the builder in hand, a window's green preview on the open edge.

notes.text: The preview: green where it fits, snapped to the open edge
The piece in hand, its cost - or why it won't go
A porch: red columns, a triangle roof
A balustrade round the roof
Front steps up to the door
